facts.fact: Executive decree 98-69 of 21 February 1998 created the Algerian Institute of Standardisation (IANOR), a public industrial and commercial establishment under the industry ministry, charged with drawing up, publishing and disseminating Algerian standards and with adopting conformity marks and authorising their use.

note: Decree names no IT or data standard and no certification against one (conformity marks only, no certifier or standard named), so only the body fact is recorded.
